title: build/validate: seed rows are never checked against the package's own validation rules; a refused seed only shows as a dropped-record log at boot
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cysZsTQwxLv9M2TzHH

Split from #34986 (its check half; the teaching half is PR #35652). Measured on main by area a4-A's dev (os-dev report 7022810829 on #34986):
- `os validate` / `os build` never run validation rules on seed rows; nothing at build or publish reports it.
- At boot the seeder logs `[Seeder] … dropped record(s)` with the rule MESSAGE, not its name.
- `os verify` exits 1 on dropped rows but names no rule, and it is not a scaffold check.

Direction already given on #34986 (6970307554): seed rows get no exemption; report it first ("check first").
Done when: a build/validate-time finding names the seed file, the row, and the refusing rule's name for every seed row the package's own validation rules refuse, with a test.
Dedupe read: seed, validation rule, os validate — only #34986.
